question:

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The Symbols has shifted one place in next images and one new symbol added from the each next boxes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96f1855512320af902a244dcbd94f25d90271575f370dd5d78bc3718f2989815.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e92e97e1e0838c9a64a92b6c1e95b9c5963c9777c1db7764f1cda33c2cb7ca56.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8be88bf731f95548fe064e98a92a01f6b3bd18a5c88690ec5b970e1f31f0478.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0081ba4de64d52f620ca1b28bc1f872a834a3e9927d0eb3ea9489d03f9be1103.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccb08ae5633ce45337d417858d8464280cf9bbfd5b1b45efd523b78295f67fa1.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e969994d3d76854897bc603eaf965edd9baf8bd1e9198e5196a224fe9ea0663f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__** A new symbol/letter is adding in both side of X alternatively, And according to the pattern, the new symbol/letter should be added before X as the given in option 2. So, Option 3 (=) eliminated here.
